provenance.note: Neer Vazhvu computation: MNDWI shoreline on Landsat 5/7/8 + Sentinel-2 via GEE, 100 m transects, weighted linear regression over the shared epochs (Dec-May median composites, MNDWI threshold 0): the same pipeline and constants as Chennai and Mumbai. No tidal correction: Visakhapatnam's spring range is 1.43 m (MHWS 1.52 m, MLWS 0.09 m above chart datum; Survey of India 2017 via CWC/NIO 2020). The per-epoch weights (EPOCH_UNCERTAINTY_M) are the Chennai study's published shoreline-position errors, borrowed as relative weights and not re-estimated for this coast. Transects on the Visakhapatnam Port inner harbour and Gangavaram port chords are dropped; those crossing OSM breakwaters/piers, on the Gangavaram port's built flanks, at the Dolphin's Nose headland or beside river mouths, and two whose measured waterline jumps 180 m or more between epochs up to 2015 (at RK Beach and north of the Gosthani mouth), carry confidence 'low' with a low_reason (seed transect_masks). We have found no published per-transect rate for this coast; the official anchor is NCCR's stretch classes (seed zones). Annual refresh (coastal-shoreline-refresh.yml).

_note: COMPUTED transect shoreline-change rates (neervazhvu): MNDWI on Landsat 5/7/8 + Sentinel-2 via GEE, 100 m transects, WLR over 10 epochs (1990-2026); no tidal correction (spring range 1.43 m). We have found no published per-transect rates for this coast; the official record is NCCR's stretch classes.
